insights: The design system uses a sophisticated pressable interaction pattern with subtle scale transforms (0.992) and custom cubic-bezier easing curves for a premium tactile feel
A comprehensive modal/sheet system is implemented with distinct enter/exit animations using different easing curves - ease-enter for appearing elements and ease-exit for disappearing ones
The navigation features a glassmorphism effect with 75% opacity white background and 10px blur, creating a modern frosted glass aesthetic while maintaining sticky positioning
